description: Explain how to plug your own Article 50(2) marking into marking.text or marking.media. Spurvik does not mark content. withSpurvik and spurvikMiddleware log the call and attach an HMAC receipt. A hook runs only when you supply one. The signed text trailer is an application-level binding you can opt into. It is not, by itself, an Article 50(2) machine-readable mark.

domain.description: Optional public website or store domain (for example, charlie-paris.com) to prefill C2PA checker and EU signup links.

locale.description: Optional EU language code (for example, de, fr, nl, da, sv, es, it) for localized C2PA guide and signup links.

surface.description: Output modality to generate EU AI Act Art. 50(2) provenance marking hooks for: text, media (images/audio/video C2PA), or both.

name: spurvik_marking_hooks
